title: Halloween Candy and Wine Pairing Experience in Historic Ybor
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the vibrant wine scene in Ybor City with a unique wine tasting experience. Over 1.5 hours, indulge in a selection of wines paired with Halloween Candy while soaking in the rich history of this historic neighborhood. Guided by knowledgeable hosts, you'll learn about wine characteristics and how to enhance your tasting skills. This social yet relaxed setting encourages a fun atmosphere for both novice and experienced wine enthusiasts alike.

- Duration: Approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes
- Small groups with a maximum of 20 participants for a personalized experience
- Includes expert guidance and a variety of wines to taste
- Conveniently located in Ybor City, with accessible transport options available
